Israel’s election chief Noam Sohlberg says the election results will stand despite serious suspicions of foreign funding aimed at influencing the vote.
In a joint statement with Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara and Shin Bet chief David Zini, Sohlberg said the allegations were serious but would not invalidate the overall election results, even if confirmed.

Captain Nasser Ebrahimi-Nejadan, 50, was hit by shrapnel in “open waters” of the Gulf.

Serbia’s central bank has shut down Alta Bank, a lender popular among Russians, over deteriorating finances and suspected money laundering. 
The move comes days after Aleksandar Vučić’s election defeat, amid reports of large withdrawals and transfers abroad. 
Alta, which facilitated Russian financial transactions following Moscow’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine, had previously faced scrutiny from the European Central Bank. 
Serbian prosecutors and the incoming student-led movement have called for an investigation into the bank’s operations and potential illicit transfers. 
Alta’s owner, Davor Macura, reportedly attempted to flee to Moscow after the election.
